rows.grounds: ablative form of 'kṣīra' (milk) with following particle/element fused in the given token; indicates starting point of a series
ellipsis marking omitted items in the sequence
instrumental plural denoting the materials used for filling
optative verb expressing a prescribed ritual action
compound or juxtaposed form referring to the aforementioned body as object

items.question: With what substances must that body be continually filled in this practice?
premises: Milk is named as the starting substance in the sequence.
Additional filling substances are indicated by the ellipsis and instrumental plural.
The prescribed action is to fill that body continually.
items.inference: Therefore, that body should always be filled with milk and other appropriate filling substances.
uncertainties: The exact substances omitted by the ellipsis '....' are not specified in this verse.
items.plain_english: One should always fill that body with milk and other such filling substances.
